title: Generation of immersed Lagrangians by cocores
summary: We extend the generation theorem of Chantraine--Dimitroglou Rizell--Ghiggini--Golovko to exact Lagrangian immersions in Weinstein manifolds. We prove that an exact Lagrangian immersion equipped with an augmentation of the Chekanov--Eliashberg algebra of its Legendrian lift, or equivalently, equipped with a corresponding bounding cochain, is generated by the Lagrangian cocores.
